table.name: TLGNC_MAINT_RHYTHM
table.description: Describes the repetition of the wagon maintenance types on a 12-year long scale. Each maintenance type (maint_type_cd) can be defined for each MAINT_RHYTHM_TYPE_CD (manual / 12-4-4 / 12-6 rhythm) once.

column.name: MAINT_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_maint_type_bs. The maintenance type. Forms the business identifier together with MAINT_RHYTHM_TYPE_CD: unique constraint (MAINT_RHYTHM_TYPE_CD, MAINT_TYPE_CD).

column.name: ACTIVATION_PERIOD_D
column.description: Number of days before event becomes active: If (last + interval_years - activation_period_d) is less than sysdate, the event counts as a candidate to be triggered. null=not planned (repair)

column.name: YEAR_1_FLAG
column.description: Set to 1=true, if the specific maintenance type of this specific variante should be repeated in the 1st year.

column.name: YEAR_2_FLAG
column.description: Set to 1=true, if the specific maintenance type of this specific variante should be repeated in the 2nd year.
